title: threat-register payload, major 3
description: Institution -> headline threat -> annual loss-event-frequency band AND the loss magnitude that goes with it. Major 3 (eco-system ticket 79 item 4) moves `lm_gbp` -- the impact per loss event -- out of the SUBSCRIBER's converter and into this, the PUBLISHER's own payload. Until major 3 the magnitudes lived in an adopter-keyed table inside platform/feeds/to_fair_scenario.py, so the platform held a number about each institution that no publisher had signed and no subscriber could re-derive. Each magnitude carries `lm_basis`, the same shape ico's penalty schema uses: a kind, a statement, a date it was read, and -- where the number is not counted -- what would make it counted. NOTE ON THE FILE NAME: majors 1 and 2 validate against payload.schema.json and are published, so repointing them would be an unreleased edit to a published major. From major 3 on, every major's schema is payload.schema.vN.json.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the loss magnitudes in this register are stated in. REQUIRED: a subscriber reading a magnitude with no declared currency would have to assume its own, which mints a currency instead of converting one (ADR-0020). Composition refuses a feed that declares none.

lef.description: min, most-likely, max annual loss events.

lm_gbp.description: min, most-likely, max IMPACT per loss event, in this payload's declared `currency`. lo <= mode <= hi.

lm_basis.description: What the magnitude rests on. A number the publisher signs and cannot say the source of is a missing instrument (ADR-0020), never a cheaper one.

lef_basis.description: What the magnitude rests on. A number the publisher signs and cannot say the source of is a missing instrument (ADR-0020), never a cheaper one.
